problem_motivation.evidence_span: However, the strength of single phase type HEAs were reported to be insufficient at elevated temperatures
the development for precipitation strengthened HEAs is only at the incipient stage, and more research efforts will be required

causal_claim.content: Positive lattice misfit produces parallel rafts during creep.
causal_claim.evidence_span: Positive misfit between FCC matrix and precipitate has yielded parallel raft microstructure during creep at 982 °C

mechanism_principle.evidence_span: the reduction of SFE due to alloying for CMSX-2 is 0.4 J/m 2 , while that for HESA should be 0.6 J/m 2

hypothesis_statement.content: Low SFE, high APB energy, and stable microstructure should strengthen HESA.
hypothesis_statement.evidence_span: HESA could be strengthened by the low stacking-fault energy of the matrix, high anti-phase boundary energy of the strengthening precipitate, and thermally stable microstructure

evidence_result.content: HESA creep rupture life rivals first-generation superalloys.
evidence_result.evidence_span: The creep rupture life of HESA at 982 °C is about 114 h, which is similar to those of several first-generation Ni-based superalloys

constraint.content: HESA creep is dominated by tertiary behavior.
constraint.evidence_span: the creep curves of HESA were dominated by tertiary creep behavior

contradiction.content: HESA creep occurs without perpendicular gamma/gamma-prime interfaces.
contradiction.evidence_span: the creep of HESA is dominated by parallel raft (P-raft) and without perpendicular γ/γ′ interfaces
